title: FirstMate and AgentSwitchboard convergence floor
intent: Record the durable AgentSwitchboard ↔ FirstMate ownership, runtime, safety, and stale-PR salvage boundaries on current main without merging the behind-main FirstMate PR stack and without vendoring FirstMate.

roles.AgentSwitchboard: control plane: machine, provider, workflow, policy, validators, evidence, and escalation
roles.FirstMate: crew chief: decompose and supervise parallel crew work under AgentSwitchboard policy while preserving isolated repository work
roles.codingAgents: workers: bounded reasoning, edits, tests, and reports inside assigned branches or worktrees
roles.tmux: reference session backend: terminal/session substrate only; does not own project decomposition or AgentSwitchboard policy

runtime.wslSupportClaim: AgentSwitchboard integration inference from upstream Linux support; upstream README does not explicitly certify WSL

upstream.rebaseNote: FirstMate PR #96 branch feat/firstmate-interop-wsl-20260808 is mergeable but far behind current main; rebase the entire stale stack onto current main before any integration merge. Do not merge PR #96 as-is.

herdr.note: Herdr is deferred and experimental-unproved. It is not part of Windows Admin Box native bootstrap now.

dependencyOrder.summary: FirstMate interop / WSL bridge foundation and integration contract
Canonical Ubuntu WSL distribution, bounded timeouts, unique evidence roots
WSL prerequisite gate before physical floor; no dependency install or credential mutation
Windows-native harness front door and portability regressions (bridge host only)
Preserve Python interpreter identity for Windows-hosted harness children

stalePrStack.integrationRule: Extract or rebase durable content onto current main. Do not cherry-pick the entire FirstMate PR stack onto this convergence floor without an explicit rebase onto current main.

claims: Tracked convergence contract and upstream pin exist and parse
Role, runtime, Herdr deferral, and first-safe-sprint invariants are machine-readable
Stale PR stack dependency order is documented
Focused static tests pass without launching FirstMate
doesNotClaim: merge of PR #96 or dependent stack PRs

operatorNext.when: After the stale FirstMate PR stack is rebased onto current main and tooling/firstmate/Test-FirstMateInterop.sh is present
operatorNext.note: Run only inside WSL/Ubuntu. Windows hosts bridge only. The probe must remain read-only: no credential mutation, no dependency installation by the ASB harness, and no live crew dispatch claim from a static pass.
